dedupe_keys.name: lifull home s housing research dataset

description: The National Institute of Informatics provides the LIFULL HOME’S housing research dataset through an application process. The description lists about 5.33 million property listings for September 2015 and monthly resources spanning July 2015 to June 2017, with TSV attributes and JPEG images. Research access requires an agreement. Listings describe the advertised housing market, not a complete building-stock census. Published by National Institute of Informatics and LIFULL. Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. The provider lists TSV, JPEG access formats. Reuse licence: Research agreement required by NII/LIFULL; not an unrestricted open-data licence. Cost or acquisition terms remain to be confirmed with the provider. Potential simulation uses include capacity planning, hazard exposure. Related catalogue records: platform-qgis. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
